## Standing operator rules
- Every change to `deploy/.env.example` must use variable prefix `LEDGERLY_PROD_` and be linked from ticket `BILL-1420`.
- Never edit `docs/CHANGELOG.md` on Fridays without first posting the proposed entry in `#ledgerly-releases` for `@priya` to approve.
- Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.
- Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Add a CSV import for vendor credits in `ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py`. SQLAlchemy upgrade is paused; pagination is complete.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Host: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is superseded.
- Pagination defaults: `limit=20`, maximum `100`; envelope: `items`, `total`, `limit`, `offset`.
- Report optimization affects `ledgerly/reports/invoice_summary.py`.

## Plan and progress
- [DONE] Optimize invoice summary queries and batch currency conversion.
- [DONE] Tests: 18 report tests passed; SQL queries reduced from 2,417 to 37.
- [PENDING] Implement vendor-credit CSV import; next step: inspect `ledgerly/imports/` and related tests.

## Recent work
Invoice summary now aggregates once per account and batch-converts minor units. Tests pass with no warnings.
